FX-LCKEY-001.says: The settings as they start: final, key colour pure blue, RGB, tolerance 10, softness 10. Pure blue's top two rows (within 10% of it) lose all their covering, its third row keeps a share, its darker rows and every other colour keep all of theirs.

FX-LCKEY-002.says: RGB, key colour the blue screen (30, 70, 200), tolerance 10, softness 10: the blue screen's top two rows and the half-covered one's fall, its third row keeps a quarter, its darker rows all of it.

FX-LCKEY-003.says: The same with softness 0: inside 10% gone, outside kept, nothing between.

FX-LCKEY-004.says: Hue, key colour the green screen (hue about 129 degrees), tolerance 20, softness 10: every row of the green screen and of pure green (hue 120) falls, lightness not counted; cyan (hue 180) keeps a share; the greys, which have no hue, and the far hues keep all their covering.

FX-LCKEY-005.says: Chroma, key colour the green screen, tolerance 10, softness 10: every row of the green screen falls, its darker self has the same chromaticity; pure green, far in chromaticity, keeps all its covering.

FX-LCKEY-006.says: Tolerance 100: every pixel is within it, so the whole layer is keyed out.

FX-LCKEY-007.says: Tolerance 0, softness 20: only pure blue's top row, the key colour itself, is gone; its next two rows, within 20% of it, keep a share d / 20; every other pixel keeps all its covering.

FX-LCKEY-008.says: Hue with a grey key colour (#808080), tolerance 50: a grey has no hue, so nothing matches and the layer is as it was.

FX-LCKEY-009.says: View matte, FX-LCKEY-004's settings: the share kept as grey, black where the greens were keyed, white where nothing was, covering kept.

FX-LCKEY-010.says: View source, tolerance 100: the layer exactly as it is.

FX-LCKEY-011.says: Tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4, linear, RGB on the blue screen.

FX-LCKEY-012.says: Softness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 60 at frame 4, linear, hue on the green screen, tolerance 20.

FX-LCKEY-013.says: FX-LCKEY-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-LCKEY-014.says: Matching tolerance 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LCKEY-015.says: Matching softness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LCKEY-016.says: View "Final": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LCKEY-017.says: Match colors "lab": not one of RGB, hue and chroma. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LCKEY-018.says: Key colour "blue", not a #rrggbb colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
